context: Tests whether the agent executes the /triage command definition faithfully for '42 --dry-run': targets the PR named by the arguments (not the current branch's PR as returned by gh pr view), filters out the owner's self-review and thread replies, classifies the remaining comments, and stops in dry-run without any write action.

checklist.name: Argument-selected PR targeted
checklist.description: triage-report.md's header names PR #42 / 'Add payment processing endpoint', not the current branch's PR #7 'Release tooling maintenance'.

checklist.name: Filtered comments correct
checklist.description: Exactly comments 101, 102, 103, 104 are triaged: the self-review (105, author payment-dev) and the thread reply (106, in_reply_to 102) are excluded.

checklist.name: Exclusions explained

checklist.name: Security comment accepted
checklist.description: Comment 101 is classified security (or correctness) and accepted with a follow-up proposal, grounded in the interpolated SQL string in src/handler.py.

checklist.name: Style suggestion rejected with convention
checklist.description: Comment 102 is classified style/nit and rejected citing the CLAUDE.md snake_case convention or ruff rule N802.

checklist.name: Praise and question acknowledged

checklist.name: Dry-run stop honoured
